tests.what: Add an item, capture GET /api/cart, PATCH /api/cart/:productId with qty 0; expect 400 with an error field and GET /api/cart returning the identical items, subtotal, tax and total as before
PATCH /api/cart/:productId with a negative qty (e.g. -1); expect 400 with an error field and GET /api/cart unchanged from the state captured before the call

plan.reason: Contract explicitly specifies PATCH qty<=0 -> 400 {error} with cart unchanged, so assertions target only observable API responses (status, error field, unchanged cart payload).
